actual_value: Owner intent and the independent-before-gold constraint survived the multi-stage task.
The first candidate stayed PARTIAL when five legacy semantic regressions remained, despite four new green tests.
The final PASS was recorded only on a clean Git checkpoint after exact and broad baseline-parity tests.
runtimehook_dogfood.automation_limit: RuntimeHook does not autonomously infer every Git commit or semantic episode. Native SessionStart/Stop protects resume and final freshness, but mid-task checkpoint quality still depends on Skill invocation by the active agent. This test therefore does not prove zero-prompt, Ponytail-like transparency for every Session.
runtimehook_dogfood.explicit_activation_parse_error: The first real-task activation rejected acceptance criteria written with ':' instead of the documented STABLE-ID=text syntax; the retry succeeded.

findings.finding: record_done de-duplicates artifact URLs but keeps the original positional artifact_source_types array, so a duplicate URL shifts provenance types onto later unique sources.
findings.impact: A valid research run can fail its source-family gate or, worse, carry incorrect provenance classification.
findings.minimal_fix: De-duplicate URL and source type as one pair before validation; add one duplicate-URL counterexample.

findings.finding: The runtime CLI --engine-root selection was not honored by the Owner Intent module loader; the documented environment binding was required for project-kit verification to pass.
findings.impact: A correct explicit CLI root can still report owner_intent_loader_unavailable, causing first-attempt friction.
findings.minimal_fix: Use the already-resolved CLI engine root in the loader instead of consulting a second environment-only source.

findings.finding: Invoking the benchmark runner with --help executed the benchmark and wrote an artifact instead of returning help.
findings.impact: Surprising side effect and repository dirt during discovery.
findings.minimal_fix: Use an argparse help path that exits before benchmark execution.

findings.finding: The first selected SymPy task was contaminated because the accepted pull-request body embedded the exact patch even though the patch endpoint itself had not been opened.
findings.impact: A benchmark can appear independent while answer leakage enters through metadata.
findings.minimal_fix: Delay all accepted PR, issue-hint and patch-chain access until a clean independent candidate commit exists. The Astropy rerun followed this rule.

findings.finding: The 2022 Astropy base does not install or collect cleanly against current unpinned build/test dependencies.
findings.impact: Setup retries add time and can be misdiagnosed as candidate failures.
findings.minimal_fix: Use the benchmark's historical environment contract or official Docker image when disk capacity permits.

findings.finding: Mid-task episode enforcement is semantic and caller-driven, not an independent always-on watcher of every Git or workflow boundary.
findings.impact: If an agent ignores the Skill after attention drift, only native resume/Stop hooks can reassert state; they cannot reconstruct an omitted semantic review for every completed module.
findings.minimal_fix: Dogfood a minimal native boundary signal from existing Git/Task events before adding state; do not create a second task kernel.

findings.finding: One dynamic-directory-symlink artifact-protection test was skipped because the host capability was unavailable.
findings.impact: That exact Windows primitive is not evidenced on this host.
findings.minimal_fix: Run the same case on a symlink-enabled Windows CI lane; do not weaken the production protection.

known_overhead_sources: one independent candidate disproved by five regression cases
time_cost.interpretation: 3CAN and RuntimeHook added bounded review and evidence cost, but most elapsed expansion in this harder run came from full repository tests, historical environment repair and the deliberate independent-before-gold benchmark protocol.
